_comment: Committed host paths for the Vast H100 SXM 80GB HBM3 box (D-768, owner 2026-09-13: the H100 transfer row). Values are FILESYSTEM LOCATIONS, never design (D-609). /dev/shm is noexec here too, so the sm_90 helper .so lives on the root filesystem. The device tile artifact binary_cohort_configs/NVIDIA_H100_HBM3.json and the Triton MoE configs are the A100's, CARRIED UNCHANGED for cross-device consistency (owner 2026-09-13 20:1xZ: 'reuse the a100 config to keep the consistency'); they were not re-tuned on this device, and the paper says so.
